ash.scm.history.noChanges: There are no changes between these versions.
ash.scm.history.help: Use Up and Down Arrow to move between commits, Home and End to move to the first and last loaded commits, and Page Up and Page Down to move by a page. Use Right Arrow to expand files and Left Arrow to collapse them. Press Enter or Space on a history item to toggle its files; on macOS, Command+Down Arrow also toggles them. Press Shift+F10 or the Context Menu key for provider actions. Use Tab to reach reference badges and Open Changes. Press Enter on Open Changes to compare all text files in that item. Press Enter on a reference badge for provider actions. Press Alt+Down Arrow to focus history details and use its actions; Escape returns to the history item. Use Filter History References to select branches and tags; Ctrl+Space toggles a reference and Enter applies the selection. Use View as List or View as Tree to change file layout. In tree mode, use Enter or the Left and Right Arrow keys on a folder to collapse or expand it. Incoming and Outgoing Changes compare the corresponding branch with its merge base. Binary changes open a read-only hexadecimal comparison. Use Up and Down Arrow to navigate expanded folders and files. Use Left Arrow to return to their parent, and Right Arrow on an expanded commit or folder to enter it. Page Up and Page Down also work from files and folders. Use Tab to reach Open File on a changed file and open its read-only historical contents. The graph selects one commit at a time. Click or press Enter or Space to select it. Escape clears the selection without collapsing files. Loading more or refreshing retains available selections and expanded files.
ash.scm.history.verbosityDescription: Announce how to open accessibility help when commit details receive focus.
ash.scm.history.detailsHelp: Commit details show the author, relative and full time, complete message, and file and line change counts. Use Left and Right Arrow in the actions toolbar to copy the full commit ID or open the commit in a browser. Use Tab and Shift+Tab to move between the message and actions within the details card. Escape returns to the commit. Press <keybinding:editor.action.accessibleView> to read these details as plain text.
ash.scm.repositories.label: Source control repositories
ash.scm.repositories.verbosityInvalid: Repositories accessibility verbosity must be a boolean.
ash.scm.repositories.verbosityDescription: Announce how to open accessibility help when source control repositories receive focus.
ash.scm.repositories.help: Repositories lists the source control repositories and worktrees available in this workspace. Use Up and Down Arrow to navigate, and Enter or Space to select a repository. Selection updates Changes, Graph and the status bar. Click the branch name in the status bar to switch branches. Each row shows the repository name, branch and changed file count. Repositories with the same name also show a distinguishing path.
ash.scm.welcome.help: Source control has no repositories yet. Open a folder or use the repository actions supplied by an extension. Use Tab and Shift+Tab to move between the available buttons. Press Enter or Space to run an action. Once a repository is available, this view shows its changes.
ash.scm.welcome.verbosityInvalid: Source control accessibility verbosity must be a boolean.
ash.scm.welcome.verbosityDescription: Announce how to open accessibility help when source control receives focus.
ash.scm.input.help: Type a message for the selected source control provider. Enter inserts a new line. Ctrl+Enter on Windows and Linux, or Command+Enter on macOS, runs the provider’s input action. Tab moves to the commit message action, when available, and then to the commit button; Shift+Tab moves to the previous control. Generate commit message requires a configured generator and changes. While generation runs, the action becomes Stop generating commit message. Switching repositories cancels generation. The toolbar and menus show actions supplied by the provider. Use the editor shortcuts to select, copy, paste, undo and redo. The input grows with its content up to ten lines and then scrolls. Each repository keeps its own draft. Escape closes this help and returns to the message.

ash.scm.history.autoRefs: Auto (current branch, upstream and base branch)

ash.scm.history.showOutgoingTitle: Source Control › Graph: Show Outgoing Changes
ash.scm.history.showOutgoingDescription: Show the outgoing changes summary for the current branch.
